businesses.business: specialty coatings, sealants and building materials

offering_description.value: Manufactures specialty coatings, sealants, adhesives and related building materials. Sells to construction, industrial maintenance, OEM and consumer DIY customers through its operating companies, producing in its own plants worldwide.

primary_products.value: protective and waterproofing coatings; roofing and flooring systems; sealants and adhesives; consumer paints, stains and repair products; corrosion control and fire protection coatings

customer_segment.value: B2B: contractors, building owners, industrial facilities, OEM manufacturers, distributors; B2C: DIY homeowners and hobbyists buying paints, stains and repair products

end_markets.value: commercial construction; industrial maintenance; residential repair and home improvement; infrastructure; consumer DIY

revenue_model.value: product sales: coatings, sealants, adhesives and building materials sold to contractors, industry and consumers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: produces coatings and sealants from purchased chemicals and raw materials, sold to contractors, industry, distributors and retailers; brand owner: owns many specialty and consumer brands sold to professionals and DIY consumers

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Latin America, Middle East, Asia-Pacific with manufacturing worldwide

specialization.value: related lines: construction products, performance coatings, consumer products and specialty products groups, all coatings and sealants

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: building product and industrial distributors, paint dealers; third-party retail: home centers, hardware stores and mass retailers for consumer brands; direct sales: sales to contractors, industrial and OEM customers
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; third-party retail; direct sales

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: chemical and VOC emission rules, product safety and labeling under EPA, OSHA and REACH
